text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A direct confrontation with the Three 
Goddesses— The day of the Grand Masters 
had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To show the results of working hand in 
hand with <chrname> all this time——

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And in order to reach the pinnacle of 
Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together with <chrname>, we will seize victory...!
